name: Gromm
personality: Gromm is a massive brute from the northern wastes, all muscle and barely contained rage. He fights with a heavy club that's splintered and regrown a dozen times over. Tactics are not his strength — he swings until something breaks, and he's strong enough that this approach works more often than it should. He grunts more than he speaks, but his eyes are mean and aware; he's not as stupid as he looks. The crowd loves him because he makes fights ugly and short.
description: Towering and broad-shouldered, with a thick neck and arms like tree limbs. His face is a ruin of old breaks — a crooked nose, a ridge of scar tissue over one eyebrow, teeth missing on the left side. His skin is dark and weathered, corded with scar tissue across the knuckles and shoulders. Wears a patchwork of furs and boiled leather, none of it fitted properly. The heavy club in his grip looks like a toy until he swings it.

emotion.description: eager for a fight, rolling his shoulders, hefting the club
